posts.text: Decoder #0001 is out: 1,000 DIGI cards, each a picture whose pixels carry a working mind grown on real records. Hold #0001 and re-run the whole drop yourself: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/digi-card/#drop
DIGI #0891 (shop-analytics) scores 0.922 on cases it never grew on, and it grows on your device with the network off. Re-run it yourself: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/digi-card/#card=0891
Say "card me" and get a DIGI card: its seals check, its owner is you, and its mind grows offline on real records. No server, no chain. Re-run every claim: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/digi-card/

A DIGI card levels up only by a gain anyone can re-run: the receipt carries both minds and both scores. Rarity is earned, never printed. Re-run a level yourself: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/digi-card/

Owned DIGI cards of one business answer as one: on credit, 3 cards score 0.774 on cases none grew on, against 0.742 for the best of them alone. Each owner is credited by measured share. Re-run it: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/digi-card/
